verdict: Second read agrees with the first on the whole: mechanically clean (0 em-dashes, the one exclamation point is inside Mark 9:24, literal forbidden-language search returns nothing; 'truly' and 'perhaps' occur only inside the Chalcedon wording and the Celsus paraphrase). Four of nine findings survive. The essay is a good human piece and most of the first reader's 'consider' items would have over-edited it. The remaining gap is presence, which only James can supply.

keep.quote: More than a thousand years later the whole Western church went through something like it. Martin Luther's Ninety-five Theses of 1517 took aim at a specific thing
keep.tell: Vague framing sentence that repeats the section's opening stamp ('went through something like this') and makes a loose claim: the Reformation was not 'something like' one man's years of doubt

keep.quote: That is not a man offering a helpful way of seeing the world. It is a claim about something that happened, and it can be weighed the way other claims about the past are weighed.

They are agreeing', and before 'didn't invent a faith of his own. He came to'). Each section has only one, so it is inside the letter of the rule, but the identical frame four times is audible. This is the one where the denial does the least new work; the first-commandment line is the true hinge and stays.

keep.replacement: The Boston Globe began reporting in January 2002 how the Archdiocese of Boston had moved priests accused of abusing children from parish to parish.

'and that loneliness is real' Dropped (consider): it names the feeling without validating despair, and the sentence around it is plain. Not something to stake the essay on.
for_james: The essay carries no first-person presence beyond 'I don't know how Harris's story ends', 'I don't think the questions are the danger' and 'Which of mine would?'. On deconstruction a reader expects you in the room. One real sentence from you near 'I don't think the questions are the danger' (what an objection looked like from inside when you were an atheist) would lift the voice score more than any edit. Nothing was invented; it is yours to give or withhold.

'Pastors can tell you about people who found serious objections to the faith in the same season they found a reason to want out of it.' is generic as it stands. If you have watched this, saying so in the first person, with no one identifiable, would be stronger.
